Source: Ubuntu archive bearssl_0.6+dfsg.1.orig.tar.xz (upstream 0.6; the
Debian repack only drops the prebuilt T0Comp.exe).  Kept: src/ and inc/

scripts/gen-tls-roots.sh) and the licence.
